title: ICS 32 Workout Projects with optional RAGMan tutors
summary: Students may complete five optional Python Workout Projects on large files, cursors, web visualization, and arithmetic expressions, with the best three counting toward the course grade. A homework-specific RAGMan tutor offers conversational guidance grounded in project descriptions and prior discussions while refusing to provide code or solutions.

assessment.summary: Complete up to five Python Workout Projects with optional, project-specific conversational AI guidance.
student_actions: Ask a RAG-grounded tutor for clarification or next-step support.

student_role.description: Students may use a dedicated tutor for each Workout Project; tutor use is optional and available continuously.

grading.method: The three highest Workout Project scores are combined; students need complete only three of five for full available credit.
